Pehchaan Ek Safar · IIT Ropar

Building an education NGO from the ground up.

Visit Pehchaan Ek Safar at IIT Ropar ↗

In 2017, friends and I co-founded Pehchaan Ek Safar at IIT Ropar to help children in underserved communities access education. As a founding member and Secretary in 2018–2019, I helped turn that shared commitment into a registered nonprofit, with a mission, constitution, team, partnerships, and a structure built for continuity.

Founding Member · 2017–present
Secretary · 2018–2019

The first classroomsLearning materialsCommunity supportThe teamMy role
01 · Showing up to teach

A classroom could begin in a field.

Some of our early classes took place under a simple thatched shelter, with chalkboards and children seated together on a mat. The setting was modest, but the purpose was clear: create a place where children could learn and volunteers could offer regular support.

That work also connected children with the IIT Ropar community. Campus visits and shared events made the initiative about both learning and belonging.

02 · Making participation possible

Putting learning materials into children’s hands.

Supporting education also meant attending to everyday needs. With help from the IIT Ropar community, we organized stationery distribution so children had materials to use in class. These moments show the practical connection between campus support and the children our initiative served.

03 · Inviting others to contribute

Taking the story beyond the classroom.

Public fundraising and outreach helped us explain why Pehchaan mattered and invite others to take part. From a donation box on campus to a stall with information about our work, we created opportunities for conversations, contributions and new connections.

As part of the founding team, I worked on fundraising and external engagement alongside the organizational work needed to turn that support into continuing educational activities.

04 · Building the team

The people who made it possible.

Behind every class and event were volunteers who gave their time to teaching, planning and coordination. Friends and I built the founding team, recruited volunteers and worked with the IIT Ropar community to establish a structure that could outlast our own time on campus.

These photographs record different parts of that shared effort, from the Paathshala team to the colleagues organizing the work behind the scenes.

2017–present

Founding Member

I co-founded the initiative with friends and worked with the founding team on registration, mission and objectives, constitution, organizational structure, volunteer recruitment, fundraising, and external partnerships.

My focus in the founding period was to help create an organization with a clear purpose and the capacity to continue through future generations of students and volunteers.

2018–2019

Secretary

As Secretary during the organization’s formative years, I led team coordination and volunteer recruitment, planned priorities, and organized our educational and outreach efforts.

I worked with fellow founders on formalizing the NGO, building relationships and MoUs with multiple organizations, fundraising, and establishing the governance and operating structure needed for sustained work.

How we built the organization
01

Mission & long-term direction

Defined aims, mission, objectives, and long-term priorities with the founding team, creating a shared direction for educational and community work.

02

Registration & constitution

Worked with fellow founders to register the NGO and develop its constitution and organizational structure. It became a registered nonprofit in 2019.

03

Team building & recruitment

Built the founding team with my co-founders, recruited volunteers, and organized responsibilities to turn a shared intention into coordinated, continuing work.

04

Partnerships & MoUs

Worked on relationships and memoranda of understanding with multiple organizations to build support and extend what the team could achieve together.

05

Fundraising & external engagement

Contributed to fundraising, outreach, and external engagement to mobilize the resources and relationships needed to sustain the NGO’s work.

06

Governance & continuity

Developed the organizational structure and long-term direction with the founding team, supporting continuity as students graduated and new volunteers took responsibility.

Why I became involved

Education opened a door for me.

Being the first in my family to pursue higher education shaped what this work meant to me. At IIT Ropar, friends and I saw an opportunity to connect the campus community with children who did not have the same access to educational support.

I am proud of the foundations we helped build and of the students, faculty mentors, and volunteers who continue to carry the organization forward. Seeing that commitment endure is an important part of what this experience means to me.

Paathshala

Steady support for school.

Free tuition, help with school admissions, learning materials, and transport support address practical barriers that can keep children out of education.

Explore Paathshala ↗
Outreach & Vigyanotsav

Making science accessible.

Hands-on STEM workshops, career guidance, and teacher training extend the NGO’s work into schools. Its annual Vigyanotsav science festival has brought together more than 25 school teams.

Explore the outreach programs ↗

A shared commitment that continues.

I know how much a chance to learn can change someone’s path. Helping build Pehchaan connected that experience with the practical work of establishing a lasting organization. Its continuing impact belongs to the community of people who have built and sustained it together.
